proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ _ ζ hζ u
  have h := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.Three.Units.mem hζ u
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
  rcases h with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · exact ⟨1, 0, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨-1, 0, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, 1, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨-1, 1, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨1, 2, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
  · exact ⟨-1, 2, by simp, by simp, by simp [h]⟩
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {3} ℚ K] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ 3) (u : (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ), ∃ (ε : ℤ) (j : ℕ), (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧ j < 3 ∧ (u : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) = (ε : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) * hζ.toInteger ^ j
